name: Paris, Banks of the Seine
description: A walk along the Seine in central Paris takes you past the Louvre, Notre-Dame, the Sainte-Chapelle, the Place de la Concorde, the Grand and Petit Palais and the Eiffel Tower. The river works like a timeline of the city's history. You can also see the wide boulevards and squares of Haussmann's 19th-century rebuilding, a model for city planners worldwide.
